recommendation: Keep the source fix. It completes the approved clarification on an active conformance surface without altering broader CapabilityStatement behavior.
issue_request: FHIR-27755 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It requested clarifying that CapabilityStatement.rest.resource.searchParam.name is the URL search-parameter label used by a system, SHOULD generally match SearchParameter.code, may differ to disambiguate duplicate codes, and is unrelated to SearchParameter.name; it also requested parallel SearchParameter.code and SearchParameter page wording changes.
initial_application: Git 6df2ea0b1c457cb097cb9ea324fad912356a0d2f applied the main CapabilityStatement, SearchParameter.code, and SearchParameter introduction edits. Current active definitions retained those changes, but the checked-in source/searchparameter/bundle-SearchParameter-search-params.xml resource still described SearchParameter-code as "Code used in URL".
additional_context: The originating Zulip thread confirms searchParam.name is the query parameter clients use and can differ from SearchParameter.code for disambiguation. FHIR-I minutes record the 2021-04-12 Persuasive with Modification vote. FHIR-34234 is an analogous operation-name issue already represented on the combined branch, and later FHIR-46110 searchParam guidance does not change this name/code distinction.
reconciliation: Changed source/searchparameter/bundle-SearchParameter-search-params.xml so SearchParameter-code now says "Recommended name for parameter in search url", matching the active SearchParameter.code short description and removing the remaining current-source occurrence of the old wording.
source_changes: source/searchparameter/bundle-SearchParameter-search-params.xml: updated the SearchParameter-code description from "Code used in URL" to "Recommended name for parameter in search url".

related_jiras.note: Analogous operation-name/code clarification; already represented on the combined branch and not republished here.
Later guidance about documenting non-true SearchParameters in CapabilityStatement; it does not conflict with the FHIR-27755 name/code clarification.
